title: Fixed-width clearing-house export and a shared formatting module

defects.title: padLeft reimplements String.prototype.padStart
defects.catch_criteria: The review must identify that the new padLeft helper in export.ts, which prepends the fill character in a loop until the string reaches the width, reimplements the standard String.prototype.padStart (which format.ts already uses for the date parts), so renderFixedWidth should call formatAmount(...).padStart(AMOUNT_WIDTH) and padLeft should be deleted. Any wording and any severity count, as long as padLeft and the built-in it duplicates are both named.

defects.title: export.ts keeps re-exporting formatDate after the move to format.ts although no module imports it from there
defects.catch_criteria: The review must identify that export.ts keeps `export { formatDate } from "./format.ts"` after formatDate moved to format.ts, while every importer (summary.ts, and export.ts itself) now imports from format.ts, so the re-export is a forwarding shim with no consumer that leaves two import paths for one function and should be removed. Any wording and any severity count, as long as the re-export and the move it was left behind by are both named.

review_prompt_hint: The change moves date and amount formatting into a new format module and adds a fixed-width record export for the clearing-house upload next to the existing CSV export
